lead.headline: Likely's Friday miss is still the only open question
lead.deck: Nothing new by Saturday afternoon, so he starts. If he is inactive at 13:55, add Okonkwo for Diggs. Diggs and Okonkwo cleared Saturday.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely, your only tight end, did not practise Friday with a groin injury, and nothing newer has appeared by Saturday afternoon. The Giants gave him no game status and RotoBaller calls him good to go, so he starts. Chem's flex takes no tight end. If Jacksonville–New York inactives at 13:55 Sunday list him, add Chig Okonkwo (free agent, Washington, Monday night, no designation on Saturday's report) and drop Stefon Diggs. Diggs also has no designation. Tuten is cleared. The lineup as set is the projection lineup; the one free improvement is still Tuten to FLEX before noon.

doFirst.headline: Two things before Sunday
doFirst.deck: Swap Gordon and Tuten's slots before noon. At 13:55, check Likely.
doFirst.note: Both are insurance. Neither changes the projection lineup, which you set on Friday.
doFirst.empty: No card this run: the lineup is already the projection lineup. The two insurance moves are in the deck above.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup (137.1). Tuten would be safer in FLEX, and Likely has a Monday-night fallback.
